simulation.opening: Original snapshot initialize + stepping; comparator saved OutputSignal15 reconciles to0, machine opens.

simulation.limitation: Continuous subsequent lever toggles in this simulator drift and do not fully open. These independently verified baked segments return to exact canonical endpoints. No claim of an indefinitely repeatable in-game machine test.
